rules.note: Scan of your passport, the one you plan to use to enter Russia. After a successful interview you also upload a certified translation of it.
A photograph, uploaded to your Education in Russia profile. Files must be JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB.

Scan of your document of education (school certificate or diploma). If you are still studying, upload a certificate from your place of study instead. A certified translation is needed after the interview.
Scan of your grades (transcript or diploma supplement). A certified translation is needed after the interview.
Postgraduate (and residency) applicants also upload a motivation letter, abstract or article on the research you plan to do.
Medical certificates for HIV, hepatitis B/C and tuberculosis, with a certified translation. You upload these only after a successful interview, when you are recommended for the final stage.
Files confirming achievements in student competitions or sport, if you have them. They can give you a competitive advantage.
